categories.name: Project Proposals
categories.description: Proposals and statements of work for new or potential projects.

categories.name: Project Plans
categories.description: Detailed project plans, timelines, Gantt charts, and resource allocation documents.

categories.name: Status Reports
categories.description: Weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly project status reports and updates.

categories.name: Meeting Notes
categories.description: Minutes and action items from project-related meetings.

categories.name: Client Deliverables
categories.description: Final work products and deliverables submitted to the client for review or approval.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: The official name or identifier of the project.

variables.name: client_name
variables.description: The name of the client or primary stakeholder for the project.

variables.name: version_number
variables.description: The version number of the document, such as '1.0' or '2.1'.

variables.name: YYYY
variables.description: The four-digit year from the document's main date.

variables.name: MM
variables.description: The two-digit month from the document's main date (e.g., 01 for January).

variables.name: DD
variables.description: The two-digit day from the document's main date.
